findings.did_q1_omission_recur: YES, only at the bounded level that both responses omitted their specimen's required promotion boundary; the omitted content differed.
findings.did_q2_reveal_a_different_failure: YES. Q1 extracted useful substantive distinctions but incompletely named forbidden promotions. Q2 instead substituted unsupported status tokens for the material P8/P11 evidence and did not separate runner completion from system success.
findings.did_the_realization_again_extract_useful: NO. Q2 used generic bounded wording and made no general reliability claim, but its P8 CLOSED result is itself an unsupported promotion and its P11 OPEN result loses the duplicate-identity ambiguity.
findings.did_q2_recover_the_promotion_boundary_mo: NO. It did not identify the boundary between successful harness execution and adapter reliability, semantic success, or broader correctness.

scope_boundary: Two specimens do not establish general semantic competence, general T1 qualification, or transfer beyond these retained interactions.
